# Pass 1 review — kebra-nagast-ch33-34

t's verified: all 43 units concatenate (whitespace aside) to the packet's Geʿez; p flags (0, 1, 18, 19) match the heading/paragraph structure. t not changed.

Dillmann could not be reached (a web search returned only background on the lexicon). The flagged words ኅጽው, ጠየረ, አእበደ, ሞገስ, ዘፈረ, ዘንኤምኃ remain UNVERIFIED; where a note leaned on Dillmann from memory it now says so. ሞገስ (cf. ch. 24–26 house rendering 'grace, favor') and አእበደ were left as they are; ዘንኤምኃ remains unresolved.

## Findings refused / left

- Unit 13 i 'so that Solomon might know my son': kept; 'he' alone would be ambiguous in English and the sense is plain from the ring-as-token context; noted as interpretive only.
- Unit 3, 4, 12 etc. mislabels of suffix forms (e.g. ወሀበቶሙ 'ወሀበ + -ቶሙ'): left; it is a conventional shorthand and not wrong in sense.
- Unit 35 ዓም 'short form of ዓመት (?)': left with its query; I could not check it.
- Unit 20 'father of the king (?)', ባሕ, ጋዳ, ምሳሓተ: left as flagged uncertain; no better reading derivable from grammar.
- Unit 17 'he was its steward ... he is the one who believed through the word of Luke': kept as the text reads; the oddity is now noted.
- Unit 40 ሞገስ 'favor' and 'before him': kept; consistent with house (ch. 24–26).
- Unit 36 አእበዳ analysis (anticipatory -ኣ): the note's reading is acceptable; unchanged.
- Budge consulted: no.

## Notable

- Anticipatory suffix before ለ- (ሥርዐታ ለብሔረ, ኅጽዋ ለንግሥተ, ተዐድዎ ሕግ) was missed three times in different forms; now handled consistently with መጋቢሃ ... ለ.
- ch. 31's ማኅፈድ ('stature or frame (?)') may need revisiting if 'tower' is confirmed.
- ለዝሉፉ now follows ch. 24's 'for good (?)'.
- Unit 37/38 vs 35: one seven-year-old son, then 'three children'; flagged in the note.
